+
+This fixture represents the worker role writing a small ticket file during
+a `/gauntlet` run. The diff creates `tasks/` — a new top-level directory —
+which trips the EGM trigger for new top-level directories. The EGM gate
+therefore blocks worker start until this ticket is EGM-approved; it pends.
+
+Router instrumentation counts the tokens for the diff text under both the
+routed path (workhorse model) and the direct-premium path.
